integrity: Exact rational formulas and analytic proof accompany reproducible standard-library checks. Finite computations do not certify the all-real-parameter theorem. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two agents and mutually independent exponential item values, with each good distributed identically across agents. Exact transition is for the four-mean family (1,2,t,t+3), t>=2. The separate large-t robustness result is not a finite-parameter classification.
title: Exponential lottery fairness: a sharp four-good boundary and a cubic phase transition
